info.name: Auth Service
info.description:
GAIA Auth Service — {{baseUrl}} (default localhost:8082).

GRUP
1. System User (SYS_PRINCIPAL / SYS_ADMIN) — platform global lintas tenant; SYSTEM, Bearer {{systemAccessToken}}
2. Tenant Admin (TENANT_ADMIN, EMPLOYEE) — admin utama 1 klinik; Bearer {{adminAccessToken}}
3. Tenant Staff & Customer — Staff (dokter/perawat/kasir): EMPLOYEE, {{staffAccessToken}}; Customer (pasien): CUSTOMER, {{customerAccessToken}}
4. Internal service-to-service — X-Service-Token saja
5. Utility

HEADER (disuntik gateway; di dev dikirim manual)
- X-Service-Token: {{gatewayServiceToken}} (wajib agar konteks diakui)
- X-Request-Context: SYSTEM | TENANT
- X-Resolved-Tenant-ID: tenant UUID (hanya TENANT)
- X-User-Context: EMPLOYEE | CUSTOMER (hanya TENANT)
- Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> (endpoint terautentikasi)
- Opsional: Idempotency-Key (POST /tenant-users), X-Correlation-Id

FORMAT: sukses {"data": ...}; error {"code","message"}.
Login menyimpan accessToken otomatis; refresh token lewat cookie HttpOnly (cookie jar Postman).
